_about: Ready-made 3D objects for vector/motion3d. Only licence-clear sources: CC0 (Kenney, Quaternius, Poly Haven, Smithsonian CC0-marked) or NASA (free under NASA media rules: no endorsement, NASA insignia never shown). Textures are never used, so printed logos and insignia never appear. Files are fetched into the cache by tools/library3d_fetch.py, never stored in git.
